stories.title: Cubs' Crow-Armstrong, Astros' Alvarez sweep votes as unanimous MVP winners
stories.summary: Cubs star Pete Crow-Armstrong and the Astros' Yordan Alvarez each earned all 30 first-place votes to win the MVP awards in their respective leagues Thursday night.

stories.title: Follow live: Commanders visit Giants in J.J. McCarthy's first home start on TNF
Harbaugh bemoans 'loophole' after nixed trade, urges NFL to look into it
stories.summary: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh on Thursday expressed frustration with the Denver Broncos about a nixed trade this week involving linebacker Daiyan Henley.

stories.title: Jefferson, Vikings see 'joy' in Cousins' first full day back with team
stories.summary: The Minnesota Vikings reveled Thursday in quarterback Kirk Cousins' first full day back with the organization.

stories.title: Cowboys CB Porter: Absence is because of ankle injury, not my contract
stories.summary: Cowboys CB Joey Porter Jr. wants it known his absence the past two weeks has everything to do with an ankle injury and nothing to do with a future contract.
